name: External Website API Tests
description: Tests for monitoring external website APIs

requests.name: Check JSONPlaceholder API
requests.tests:
pm.test('Response status is 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Response has correct structure', function() { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('userId'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('body'); });

requests.name: Check HTTPBin Headers
requests.tests: pm.test('Response includes our custom header', function() { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.headers).to.have.property('Custom-Header'); pm.expect(body.headers['Custom-Header']).to.equal('Pigeon-Test'); });
